alt: Goku smiling outside her school in Ghana

story.name: Goku
story.impact: Goku and her peers can continue their education and pursue the careers they want.
story.body:
Goku is a brilliant student, quick with numbers and set on becoming a banker. She left school to support her family in the 8th grade, until a teacher persuaded her to return. She has just graduated from the 9th grade but faces barriers to continue to High School.

Beast Philanthropy created an Education Fund that covers the cost burden to families to send their kids to high school. It is part of MrBeast's wider effort to move children in Ghana's cocoa region out of farm labor and into classrooms, since poverty is the strongest driver of child labor in these communities.

Goku and her peers can continue their education and pursue the careers they want.

alt: Hannah smiling beside stacked baskets in her community

story.name: Hannah
story.impact: Hannah is now employed in steady, safe work, her children have a brand new school to attend and she has become a leader in the community.
story.body:
Hannah farms cocoa and raises twelve children, cooks for the school lunch program, and leads the community's savings group.

Beast Philanthropy built a proper kitchen at the school so the school meal program will provide safe and nutritious meals to students and provide the cooks with the proper environment and income to do their work. Hannah also leads the Village Savings and Loans Association that we started to teach financial literacy to women in the community and support their savings journey so they can generate additional income through business ventures.

Hannah is now employed in steady, safe work, her children have a brand new school to attend and she has become a leader in the community.

alt: Francis Njokum, Director of CDVTA, in Cameroon

story.name: Francis Njokum
story.impact: 16 solar-powered water wells and a new school now serve communities and students across Cameroon.
story.body: Francis Njokum is the Director of CDVTA. Under his leadership, over a period of three years, CDVTA helped MrBeast and Beast Philanthropy construct 16 water wells serving both schools and communities across Cameroon. These wells are supported by solar energy installations that help water flow. Beast Philanthropy also funded the construction of a new school in Cameroon, creating cleaner and more conducive learning environments for both students and teachers.

alt: Sheetal sitting in a tailoring workshop lined with sewing machines

story.name: Sheetal
story.impact: By fostering collective action and mentorship, this program empowers young women to break cycles of hardship, securing the schooling and resources necessary to transform their own destinies.
story.body:
Sheetal began attending programs at Udayan Care when she was just 4 years old. Now grown, Sheetal credits Udayan Care with inspiring her to dream big and not lead a life of poverty.

Beast Philanthropy provided funding for 270+ scholarships to help future generations of girls like Sheetal.

By fostering collective action and mentorship, this program empowers young women to break cycles of hardship, securing the schooling and resources necessary to transform their own destinies.

alt: Grandma J resting a hand against her face

story.name: Grandma J
story.impact: Inspired by Grandma J, Beast Philanthropy pledged an additional sum to CarePortal that was estimated to help an additional 1,000 children and families.
story.body:
Grandma J had been preparing for retirement when life took a turn; she became the full-time caregiver to her three grandchildren. With one child already in the foster care system, she returned to work and has since been tirelessly and selflessly providing for her family. She never complains. But behind her strength is a constant fear: that if she can't keep up with the mounting bills or plumbing issues, she might lose her grandchildren, too.

Beast Philanthropy pledged via CarePortal to help Grandma J provide a safe and warm home for her grandchildren, including providing rental assistance and helping with a vehicle that accommodates all of them.

Inspired by Grandma J, Beast Philanthropy pledged an additional sum to CarePortal that was estimated to help an additional 1,000 children and families.

alt: Timber singing into a microphone outdoors
Isaac smiling outside the school where he teaches in Ghana

story.name: Isaac
story.impact: Isaac's family moved out of the overcrowded compound and into a home of their own, with running water and a private bathroom for the first time.
story.body:
Isaac teaches at Career Technologies and lives with his wife and child in a rented compound, where about forty people share two toilets and collect water from a nearby unsafe well.

Beast Philanthropy built new homes for the school's teachers, each a private house with running water and its own sanitation, so staff can focus more on teaching, stay healthier and worry less about transportation.

Isaac's family moved out of the overcrowded compound and into a home of their own, with running water and a private bathroom for the first time.

alt: Gifty smiling outside a school building in Ghana

story.name: Gifty
story.impact: Gifty now runs a school that's healthier, better staffed, and worth showing up for, one where kids have a real reason to come every day.
story.body:
Gifty is the Headmistress of the largest school in her community, managing 14 teachers and 330 students from kindergarten through junior high. She's a driving force in the community and a steady partner in the work of getting kids off the farm and into the classroom.

Beast Philanthropy rebuilt her school, built new homes for 10 of her teachers, and brought clean water to campus so students and teachers stop getting sick.

Gifty now runs a school that's healthier, better staffed, and worth showing up for, one where kids have a real reason to come every day.
